getById.description: Gets an entry from 'matches' by its primary key

create.sql: INSERT INTO matches (player1id, player2id, winnerid, refereeid, matchdate, matchround, durationtime, tournament) VALUES ($player1id, $player2id, $winnerid, $refereeid, $matchdate, $matchround, $durationtime, $tournament)

update.description: Updates an existing entry in 'matches' by its primary key
update.sql: UPDATE matches SET player1id = $player1id, player2id = $player2id, winnerid = $winnerid, refereeid = $refereeid, matchdate = $matchdate, matchround = $matchround, durationtime = $durationtime, tournament = $tournament WHERE matchid = $matchid

delete.description: Deletes an existing entry in 'matches' by its primary key
